data.name: Mumin
data.gender_notes: Mumin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has strong faith in Allah and His Messenger. In Islamic tradition, Mumin refers to someone who is true and sincere in their beliefs. The name Mumin carries the meaning “Faithful, Believer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mumin usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, believer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Mumin is described as one who has strong faith and conviction in Allah's existence and unity (Tawhid).
data.etymology: Mumin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Believer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mumin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: مومن
in_urdu.long_meaning: مومن وہ شخص ہے جو الله پر ایمان رکھتا ہے اور اس کے نبیوں پر، اور ایمان اور صدق کے ساتھ مشہور ہے، اور یہ الله کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیے گئے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुमिन

It is used to denote a person who not only believes in Allah (God) but also strives to follow Islamic values, principles, and teachings in their daily life. In the Islamic community, being referred to as a Mumin is considered an honor, signifying a strong commitment to faith and a good character.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the term Mumin represents a person's unwavering faith and devotion to Allah. It symbolizes a strong bond between Allah and the person, as well as a deep comprehension and acceptance of Islamic teachings. The path to becoming a Mumin requires continuous effort, as one must strive to maintain their faith, avoid sin, seek knowledge, and contribute to the well-being of the community.
